entry.title: Airbnb says it’s launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027
entry.summary: Airbnb says its upcoming AI agent will help travelers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings, and get assistance throughout their stay.

entry.title: Meta, Google, and TikTok sue California AG over teen social media law
entry.summary: If it goes into effect next year, this California law would restrict social media access for children under 16.

entry.title: The New York Times reportedly in talks to buy Letterboxd for $330 million
entry.summary: Letterboxd, an online platform for movie lovers, has grown dramatically in recent years.

entry.title: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M
entry.summary: Clutch, backed by Lightspeed and SignalFire, was last valued at $85 million, according to a source.

entry.title: At least 10 local governments have moved to drop Flock’s surveillance cameras since summer
entry.summary: The concerns range from privacy to how data is shared (and with whom) to procurement concerns.

entry.title: Tesla will stop making the Cybertruck in 2027
entry.summary: The decision to wind down the EV comes after just a few short years of underwhelming sales. Elon Musk said the company will use the factory space to make more Cybercabs.

entry.title: Physicl raises $10M to make the digital world real enough for robots
entry.summary: Physicl is trying to solve the sim-to-real gap with a pipeline originally built to market goods online.

entry.title: Underdog shows off a 32MB speech model in new demo
entry.summary: Despite its small size, Underdog's new model can generate both speech and music.

entry.title: After blocking Muse, Amazon now lets users text Alexa to help them shop
entry.summary: Amazon said that the feature will roll out to millions of users in coming weeks.

entry.title: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
entry.summary: AI usage keeps climbing, but spending has stalled. Price cuts and smarter cost controls among the biggest spenders could challenge investor assumptions about AI hypergrowth.

entry.title: Fox completes its $22B acquisition of Roku
entry.summary: A few months after DOJ investigators were probing the deal, Fox just completed its $22B acquisition of the streaming giant Roku.

entry.title: Pentagon offers battery startup 6K $250M loan to build US factory
entry.summary: The Pentagon has conditionally approved a $250 million loan to help 6K scale up its microwave-plasma battery material manufacturing process.

entry.title: After the midterms, is the AI industry in for a rough two years?
entry.summary: Democrats’ historic victories in this week’s U.S. midterm elections could also transform the tech industry. The public voted on 41 data center-related ballot measures on Tuesday — in all but one, the majority voted to impose more restrictions on data center development. entry.title: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent
entry.summary: Meta's Muse agents continue to get new features and integrations. Spaces promises to be a new way to interact with the AI helpers.

entry.title: Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web
entry.summary: Security researchers found hundreds of servers hosting the penetration testing tool Artex exposed to the internet, allowing anyone access to the hacking tool.

entry.title: The Duo apps are coming, says Apple
entry.summary: There are now 100,000 Duo-optimized apps, says Apple, and thousands more arrive daily.

entry.title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
entry.summary: OpenAI has reportedly raised an additional $11 billion as part of a funding round that hasn't closed yet but is expected to in the coming weeks.

entry.title: Crusoe sells troubled Wyoming data center project to Google
entry.summary: The deal highlights the challenges of developing massive AI data centers.

entry.title: From the front row to the hot seat — what the midterms mean for Big Tech
entry.summary: After spending two years getting cozy with the White House, Big Tech is suddenly trying to make friends with Democrats, and the open question is whether that image makeover can hold up against what states, local communities, and the markets are about to do.

entry.title: Sequoia shutting down its Scouts program marks the end of an era
entry.summary: Sequoia pioneered the scouts model and many VC firms followed suit, but a consensus now seems to be forming that the model has reached limits in its current form.
